messages:
alex: FYI inbound from ProspectCo. they want to swap CompetitorX for Redwood with minimal app changes. main asks: drop-in adapter, parity for prompts + streaming, pricing delta, and a security/compliance checklist. looping in SE/infra/legal. cc @diya @leon @uma @harry @priya

diya: good call. propose a two-week POC: week1 functional parity (10 canonical prompts + 500 sessions), week2 load/edge cases + billing capture. need their sample sessions and exact header/auth format.

leon: regarding auth, CompetitorX uses APIKey in `Authorization: ApiKey <key>` and two rate tiers (500 r/s burst, 50 r/s steady). we should emulate both. also capture tokenization differences.

uma: infra note: we can spin up a temporary compatibility endpoint `api.redwood.com/prospectco/compat` that rewrites headers and normalizes responses. will need their CIDR for allowlist and expected qps.

harry: security asks: they submitted a vendor questionnaire + DPA. items flagged: data residency for EU customers, encryption KMS, and request for proof of recent pen test. we'll return SOC2 report + redacted pen test. HSM requests escalate timeline ~3-5 weeks.

priya: legal: they want a clause about content-related claims. we typically decline broad indemnities; offer a limited-liability cap and standard content warranty disclaimers. also need to know expected ARR to gauge concessions.

alex: ARR estimate is $400k ACV (mid-six). procurement contact is kate.procure@prospectco.com. they prefer hosted first.

diya: technical parity detail: CompetitorX uses deterministic generation (temp=0) and an old tokenizer which sometimes splits emojis differently. we'll run tests with temp=0 and also with their streaming chunk cadence. add a token-compare metric for delta.

leon: I'll add a normalization step in the shim to map their streaming chunk events (they send `event: chunk` with base64 payload) into our JSON-lines streaming. sample snippet:```python
# simple shim: base64->jsonline
for ev in incoming.stream():
  if ev.type == 'chunk':
    payload = base64.b64decode(ev.data)
    out.write(json.dumps({'type':'delta','text':payload.decode()} ) + "\n")
```

uma: sandbox IPs added: 54.85.23.10/32, 34.210.0.0/24. sandbox URL: https://sandbox.redwood.com/prospectco (expires 10 days). using `redwood-compat-1`. logs + metrics enabled.

harry: send them SOC2 cert + KMS rotation example logs. ask if they need key provenance / HSM. also ask if they will accept audit export rather than managed HSM.

priya: also confirm data deletion SLA for POC data. marketing/legal sometimes require 90-day retention max for POC.

alex: they want data flushed after 7 days for POC sessions. ok to set retention to 7d in sandbox.

diya: evaluation criteria suggestion: 1) top-1 semantic overlap >= 0.85 (embedding cosine on responses), 2) average token delta < 8 tokens per session, 3) 95th latency within 1.5x of CompetitorX for streaming paths. agree?

leon: reasonable. i'll add an automated runner that replays their sessions and produces a CSV of comparisons.

uma: provisioning note: if they hit sustained >2k r/s we may need a dedicated pool; recommend starting hosted with autoscale and switch to Dedicated if cost/latency requires.

harry: procurement also asks for proof of cyber insurance. legal can provide certificate but need limits to match their SOW.

priya: we'll circulate a redline of their DPA + vendor Q by EOD.

alex: action items: leon -> shim + runner; diya -> eval checklist + pricing delta; uma -> sandbox + allowlist; harry -> security docs; priya -> legal redlines. kickoff Wed 9am PT. any blockers?

harry: blocker: if they insist on HSM or EU-only hosting for entire product (not just POC) that will push timeline. otherwise good.

kate (prospectco via email): shared sample sessions here: https://files.prospectco.com/poc-sessions-2026 (access key in DM). also sent their vendor form.

leon: runner pushed: https://github.com/redwood-inference/prospectco-poc/commit/ef12c3 
 includes session replayer + token-compare tool. starting first-pass run now.

diay: posted provisional pricing calc: https://spreadsheets.redwood.com/drive/poc-pricing-prospectco 
 headline: with KV & batching projected ~18% cost advantage vs their quoted per-request pricing at 10M tokens estimate. numbers subject to change.

alex: thanks all 680 see you Wed 9am PT.
